summary: Wipro Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing updates to its share buyback offer. The company is buying back up to 600 million equity shares (5.72% of paid-up capital) at ₹250 per share in cash, aggregating ₹150 billion. The tender offer route is used, with a record date of June 5, 2026. JM Financial Limited is the manager; KFin Technologies is the registrar. The buyback is proportionate among eligible shareholders. This is an issuer tender for capital returns. Watch for acceptance levels; no premium disclosed as the buyback is at a fixed price to market.
